interface_detail: The status page at https://vpn.ac/status lists node hostnames, which resolve by DNS to the exit addresses; no JSON API was found.
tooling: Reading the exits needs the status page and a DNS resolver; using one needs the vendor client or OpenVPN, WireGuard or StrongSwan configs from an account. The page names a SecureProxy browser addon; its protocol was not established.
chaining: A free compute node dials the tunnel and the traffic leaves at one of 61 addresses; 16 are in M247 (AS9009), 32 ASNs in all.
